final: WITH rc AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client c JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM rc WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), sh AS (SELECT rc.region, rc.cnt, CAST(rc.cnt AS REAL) / tot.total AS share FROM rc JOIN tot ON tot.total IS NOT NULL), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM sh WHERE share IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT sh.cnt, sh.share, sh.share - av.avg_share AS diff FROM sh JOIN av ON av.avg_share IS NOT NULL WHERE sh.share > av.avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM kept
